_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The images below are the official Qdrant ones; the sandbox needs no wrapper, because they already carry bash, which is the only HTTP client this adapter has (the image has no curl, wget, nc or python3 — measured 2026-08-30). The baseline is 1.19, the current line, with 1.18 beside it. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
name: Qdrant

sources.qdrant_snapshot_dir: A directory of them; the newest by file time is restored (no Qdrant snapshot records when it was taken)
